title: A Busy Sunday
setting: A bright bedroom on a sunny day.

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: a young girl with long brown hair and a blue skirt

sentences.en: On Sunday, Lily stays in her bedroom.
sentences.zh: 在周日，莉莉待在她的卧室里。
sentences.scene_prompt: A young girl with long brown hair sits in a bright bedroom.

sentences.en: She puts a pretty skirt on the bed.
sentences.zh: 她把一件漂亮的裙子放在床上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A young girl with long brown hair puts a pretty pink skirt on a bed.

sentences.en: She finds a white sock or a blue one.
sentences.zh: 她找了一只白袜子或者一只蓝袜子。
sentences.scene_prompt: A young girl with long brown hair looks at a white sock and a blue sock on the floor.

sentences.en: Her left side feels a little cold.
sentences.zh: 她的左侧感觉有一点冷。
sentences.scene_prompt: A young girl with long brown hair hugs herself while standing near the left side of the bed.

sentences.en: She keeps a glass of water nearby.
sentences.scene_prompt: A young girl with long brown hair sits near a glass of water on a small table.

sentences.en: The chips are too hot to eat now.
sentences.zh: 这些薯条现在太烫了，没法吃。
sentences.scene_prompt: A young girl with long brown hair looks at a bowl of hot chips on a table.

sentences.en: She had a good feeling once today.
sentences.zh: 她今天曾经有过一种很好的感觉。
sentences.scene_prompt: A young girl with long brown hair smiles happily in her sunny bedroom.
